violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Arranged for Supervision (26 TAC §746.4601(1))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Arranged for Supervision
violation_type.typical_finding: During the monitoring inspection trash was observed on the outdoor playground where children in care play.  Bird feces was also observed on a slide children in care were utilizing during outdoor play time.  There was also an entrapment hazard observed between two gates on the outdoor playground.

finding_variants.text: During the monitoring inspection trash was observed on the outdoor playground where children in care play.  Bird feces was also observed on a slide children in care were utilizing during outdoor play time.  There was also an entrapment hazard observed between two gates on the outdoor playground.
Four children were viewed hiding under an opening of the bleachers playing hide and seek.
This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. Indoor furniture was arranged in a way that did not allow for caregivers to properly supervise.
During inspection, the playground area was not ready. Playground equipment was observed not to be anchored.
A child was on a device called the "spinning dummy" with another child and caregiver was not nearby for supervision.

Large pieces of a tree were observed on the playground accessible to children. Nails/screws were observed protruding from wood in the sandbox.Cleaning supplies were observed accessible to children.  There small trash can in the restroom used by children does not have a cover or lid to prevent children's access. The trash can in the kitchen does not have a lid or cover to prevent children's access. Garbage/trash must be made inaccessible to children.
